title: PinFuse: Spatial Transcriptomics Data Denoising through Neural Advection-Diffusion Operator
titleCn: PinFuse: 基于神经对流扩散算子的空间转录组去噪
statusCn: 科研实习生 · Yi Zhang教授
summary: Light-weight Graph Variational Auto-Encoder paired with a neural advection-diffusion operator, denoising and deblurring spatial transcriptomics data with zero-inflated negative binomial reconstruction and mass conservation.
summaryCn: 结合轻量级图变分自编码器和神经对流扩散算子，并结合零膨胀负二项重建与质量守恒约束，实现空间转录组数据去噪去模糊。
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics resolves gene expression in situ, but the measured counts conflate the underlying expression field with two distinct corruptions: zero-inflated observation noise, and the physical diffusion of transcripts during wet-lab capture. Denoisers that treat this as generic count imputation address only the former, and may redistribute expression in ways the underlying transport does not permit. This work presents PinFuse, a lightweight graph variational auto-encoder built on Position-induced Transformer (PiT) variants, whose decoder is a neural advection-diffusion operator. Casting deblurring as an explicit transport process lets the model preserve localized graph structure and satisfy mass conservation by construction, while a zero-inflated negative binomial likelihood accounts for the observation noise; probabilistic inference is implemented in Pyro. PinFuse improves gene reconstruction, latent clustering, and marker purity over recent methods including ResolVI. A manuscript is in preparation for 2026.
abstractCn: 空间转录组能在原位测量基因表达，但观测计数中混杂了两种性质不同的失真：零膨胀观测噪声，以及湿实验捕获阶段转录本的物理扩散。把问题当作一般性计数填补的去噪方法只处理了前者，且可能以底层输运过程并不允许的方式重新分配表达量。本工作提出 PinFuse：一个基于 Position-induced Transformer（PiT）变体的轻量级图变分自编码器，其解码器是一个神经对流扩散算子。将去模糊建模为显式的输运过程，使模型在构造上即保持局部图结构与质量守恒，而零膨胀负二项似然负责刻画观测噪声，概率推断由 Pyro 实现。相较 ResolVI 等近期方法，PinFuse 在基因重建、潜空间聚类与 marker 纯净度上均有提升。论文准备中，预计 2026 年发表。

coverAltCn: 青色的学习轨迹穿过深色模型状态网格。
details: Formulated denoising as reconstruction of a zero-inflated negative binomial distribution on a spatial graph.
Improved downstream tasks including latent clustering, cell-level and bin-level classification.
Publication in preparation; the project will be released alongside the paper this year.
detailsCn: 将去噪建模为在空间图上重建零膨胀负二项分布。
提升了潜变量聚类、细胞级与 bin 级分类等下游任务。
论文准备中，项目将在今年随论文一并发布。

title: MissingJiT: Learning the Joint Distribution of Satellite Imagery from Missing Data
titleCn: MissingJiT: 从缺失数据中学习卫星影像的联合分布
statusCn: 科研助理 · Zuchuan Li老师
summary: MissingJiT learns the joint distribution of satellite imagery directly from incomplete observations, then performs posterior sampling in the resulting flow-matching model — a flow-matching analogue of DPS with an SSIM likelihood.
summaryCn: MissingJiT 直接从不完整观测中学习卫星影像的联合分布，并在得到的 flow matching 模型上做后验采样——即 DPS 在 flow matching 上的对应形式，并以 SSIM 似然替代 L2。
abstract: Diffusion posterior sampling (DPS) turns a pretrained generative model into a solver for general inverse problems by augmenting its score with a likelihood gradient, but it rests on two assumptions that fail for real sensor data: the forward process must be variance-preserving, and a score function must already model the joint distribution of complete high-dimensional data. Satellite imagery violates both — clouds, sensor gaps, and failed acquisitions leave only incomplete observations, so no complete dataset exists from which to learn the joint. MissingJiT is a framework that learns this joint distribution directly from missing data and performs posterior sampling in the resulting flow-matching model. First, a pixel-space Just image Transformer (JiT) learns the joint distribution of satellite imagery by discarding missing patches at tokenization, packing variable-length sequences with masked attention, and marginalizing over the missing mechanism under a missingness-at-random assumption. Second, because flow matching is not a VP-SDE, the stochastic differential equation whose time-marginals match the linear-interpolation flow is derived, along with its time-reversed probability-flow ODE and the isolated score term, yielding a flow-matching analogue of DPS. Third, the standard L2 likelihood is replaced with a differentiable structural-similarity (SSIM) distance to preserve fine-scale texture that L2 tends to blur. Unconditioned sampling already reveals realistic geophysical structure, and conditioning on partial observations enables spatially coherent inpainting.
abstractCn: Diffusion posterior sampling（DPS）通过在 score 上叠加似然梯度，把预训练生成模型变成通用反问题求解器，但它依赖两个在真实传感器数据上不成立的假设：前向过程必须是方差保持（variance-preserving）的，且必须已有一个 score 函数刻画了完整高维数据的联合分布。卫星影像同时违背这两点——云层、传感器缺口与失败的获取只留下不完整观测，因此并不存在可用于学习联合分布的完整数据集。MissingJiT 直接从缺失数据中学习该联合分布，并在得到的 flow matching 模型上执行后验采样。其一，用像素空间的 Just image Transformer（JiT）学习卫星影像的联合分布：在 tokenization 阶段丢弃缺失 patch，用掩码注意力打包变长序列，并在随机缺失（missingness-at-random）假设下对缺失机制做边缘化。其二，由于 flow matching 并非 VP-SDE，推导了时间边缘分布与线性插值流一致的随机微分方程，及其时间反演的 probability-flow ODE 与独立的 score 项，从而得到 DPS 在 flow matching 上的对应形式。其三，将标准 L2 似然替换为可微的结构相似性（SSIM）距离，以保留 L2 容易模糊掉的细尺度纹理。无条件采样已能呈现真实的地球物理结构，而以部分观测为条件则可实现空间连贯的影像补全。

title: Enhancing Ocean Surface Oxygen Representation via Relative Spatial Embedding
titleCn: 通过相对空间嵌入增强海洋表层氧表示
statusCn: 科研助理 · Zuchuan Li老师
summary: Investigating relative spatial embedding for ocean surface feature representation with Vision Transformer variants on hundreds of gigabytes of satellite time-series data.
summaryCn: 在数百 GB 的卫星时序数据上，结合 Vision Transformer 变体研究相对空间嵌入对海洋表层特征表示的作用。
abstract: Ocean surface fields are observed as massive, irregularly sampled satellite time series, and it remains unsettled how spatial position should enter a transformer applied to such data. This work reproduces, modifies, and examines several transformer variants — Vision Transformer, Position-induced Transformer, and Relative Position Embedding — to assess whether relative spatial embedding improves ocean surface feature representation. Supporting the study, a satellite data matching system and a corresponding data loader stream time-series datasets at the hundreds-of-gigabytes scale, so that comparisons run on the full record rather than a convenient subset.
abstractCn: 海洋表层场以海量、非规则采样的卫星时序形式被观测，而在这类数据上如何向 Transformer 注入空间位置信息仍无定论。本工作复现、修改并分析了若干 Transformer 变体——Vision Transformer、Position-induced Transformer 与 Relative Position Embedding——以评估相对空间嵌入是否能改善海洋表层特征表示。为支撑该研究，实现了卫星数据匹配系统与配套数据加载器，可流式处理数百 GB 规模的时序数据集，使比较建立在完整记录而非便于处理的子集之上。
coverAlt: Geometric shapes and cyan circle on a warm grid background.
coverAltCn: 几何形状与青色圆点，置于暖色网格背景上。
details: Built a satellite data matching pipeline and scalable data loader for hundreds of GB of time-series data.
Empirically compared absolute and relative spatial embeddings on ocean surface feature prediction.
detailsCn: 搭建了卫星数据匹配流程与可扩展数据加载器，用于数百 GB 时序数据。
对海洋表层特征预测中的绝对与相对空间嵌入进行了实证比较。

title: Gene Expression Field Estimation via Poisson Resampling and Neural ODEs
titleCn: 通过泊松重采样与神经 ODE 估计基因表达场
statusCn: 科研实习生 · Yi Zhang教授
summary: Modeling spatial transcriptomics as Poisson sampling on a diffused gene expression field, with a reversed Neural ODE process for reliable sample generation.
summaryCn: 将空间转录组建模为扩散后基因表达场上的泊松采样过程，并用反向神经 ODE 生成可靠样本。
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics returns sparse counts drawn from a continuous expression field that has already been blurred by transcript diffusion, which makes recovering the field an inverse problem rather than a smoothing exercise. This work formulates the measurement as a spatial Poisson sampling process over a diffused gene expression field, and reconstructs the field by reversing the diffusion with a Neural ODE. Since the reversed process is difficult to train from sparse supervision alone, training combines supervised pretraining with semi-supervised operator learning. The resulting model reconstructs the mean field accurately from sparse samples, and treats advection-diffusion simulation as an explicit forward model for biological measurement rather than an analogy.
abstractCn: 空间转录组给出的是稀疏计数，而它们采自一个已被转录本扩散模糊过的连续表达场，因此恢复该场是一个反问题，而非简单的平滑处理。本工作将测量过程形式化为扩散后基因表达场上的空间泊松采样，并用神经 ODE 反演扩散来重建该场。由于仅凭稀疏监督难以训练反向过程，训练结合了监督预训练与半监督算子学习。所得模型能从稀疏样本准确重建均值场，并把对流扩散仿真作为生物测量的显式前向模型，而不只是一个类比。
coverAlt: Cyan learning trajectory drawn through a dark grid of model states.
coverAltCn: 青色的学习轨迹穿过深色模型状态网格。
details: Combined supervised pretraining with semi-supervised operator learning to stabilize reversed Neural ODE training.
Reconstructed gene expression mean fields from sparse samples on 2D tissue grids.
detailsCn: 结合监督预训练与半监督算子学习，稳定了反向神经 ODE 的训练。
在二维组织网格上从稀疏样本重建了基因表达均值场。

title: Solving Time Series Inverse Problem by Combining Bayesian-PINN with Kalman Filter
titleCn: 结合 Bayesian-PINN 与 Kalman 滤波求解时间序列反问题
statusCn: 科研助理 · Zuchuan Li教授
summary: A Bayesian-PINN and Kalman Filter hybrid for field dynamics inverse problems, with a patched covariance method to improve filter performance.
summaryCn: 基于 Bayesian-PINN 与 Kalman 滤波的混合模型，用于场动力系统反问题，并通过补丁协方差方法提升滤波性能。
abstract: Recovering the state or the parameters of a field dynamical system from sparse, noisy time series requires both a physical prior and a calibrated notion of uncertainty; a deterministic PINN supplies the former and a filter the latter, but neither supplies both. This work couples Bayesian neural networks, physics-informed neural networks, and stochastic differential equations with a Kalman filter, so that a physics-constrained posterior is propagated forward in time and fused with incoming observations. Because a discretized field leaves the global covariance impractical to form or invert, a patched covariance method restricts the estimate to spatially local blocks, which lowers cost and improves stability when observations are sparse or irregular. The pipeline is implemented in PyTorch with a CUDA-accelerated differentiable 2D advection-diffusion solver as the neural operator backend; the patched covariance improves convergence speed and stability over a full-covariance baseline.
abstractCn: 要从稀疏、含噪的时序观测中恢复场动力系统的状态或参数，既需要物理先验，也需要可校准的不确定性；确定性 PINN 只提供前者，滤波器只提供后者，二者单独都不够。本工作将贝叶斯神经网络、物理信息神经网络与随机微分方程同 Kalman 滤波耦合，使受物理约束的后验沿时间向前传播，并与新到观测融合。由于物理场离散化后全局协方差难以构造与求逆，分片协方差方法把估计限制在空间局部块上，从而降低开销，并在观测稀疏或不规则时更稳定。整套流程基于 PyTorch 实现，并以一个 CUDA 加速的可微二维对流-扩散求解器作为神经算子后端；相较全协方差基线，分片协方差在收敛速度与稳定性上均有改善。
coverAlt: Geometric shapes and cyan circle on a warm grid background.
coverAltCn: 几何形状与青色圆点，置于暖色网格背景上。
details: Implemented B-PINN-Kalman in PyTorch and replicated related flow estimation and image generation papers.
Built a CUDA-accelerated 2D advection-diffusion fluid solver as a neural operator backend.
detailsCn: 在 PyTorch 中实现了 B-PINN-Kalman，并复现了相关流场估计与图像生成论文。
构建了 CUDA 加速的二维对流-扩散流体求解器作为神经算子后端。

title: WebGL Implementation of Reflective Gaussian Splatting (Ref-Gaussian)
statusCn: 代表作 · 许世新老师
summary: Browser-native WebGL pipeline for Ref-Gaussian rendering at 60+ FPS, with COLMAP-to-Docker end-to-end tooling and Approximate Tangent Axis estimation for Gaussian Surfels.
summaryCn: 面向 Ref-Gaussian 渲染的浏览器原生 WebGL 管线，可在 60+ FPS 下运行，并配有 COLMAP 到 Docker 的端到端工具链以及 Gaussian Surfels 的近似切轴估计。
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting renders photorealistic novel views in real time, and Reflective Gaussian Splatting (Ref-Gaussian) extends it to glossy and reflective materials, yet browser-native implementations either drop those physically based properties or fail to hold interactive frame rates on consumer hardware. This work ports the Ref-Gaussian pipeline to WebGL with custom shaders, optimized loading, and explicit memory budgeting. For Gaussian Surfels rasterization it proposes Approximate Tangent Axis (ATA) estimation, which produces smoother position maps and more stable shading across curved and reflective regions, while early alpha discard, chunk-level view-frustum culling, and chunk-based lazy updates raise throughput further. Delivered end to end — COLMAP reconstruction, Ref-Gaussian inference, post-processing, and Docker-based web deployment — the renderer sustains 60+ FPS on a consumer laptop (RTX 4060 Laptop) at markedly lower GPU utilization than a naive port.
abstractCn: 3D Gaussian Splatting 能实时渲染照片级真实感的新视角，反射高斯泼溅（Ref-Gaussian）进一步将其扩展到光泽与反射材质，但浏览器原生实现往往要么舍弃这些基于物理的属性，要么在消费级硬件上达不到可交互帧率。本工作将 Ref-Gaussian 管线移植到 WebGL，配以自定义着色器、加载优化与显式的内存预算控制。针对高斯面片光栅化，提出近似切轴（ATA）估计，使位置图更平滑、在曲面与反射区域的着色更稳定；早期 alpha 丢弃、chunk 级视锥剔除与分块懒更新进一步提升吞吐。整套流程端到端交付——COLMAP 重建、Ref-Gaussian 推理、数据后处理与 Docker Web 部署——在消费级笔记本（RTX 4060 Laptop）上稳定保持 60+ FPS，且 GPU 占用显著低于朴素移植版本。

title: Blender Development
summary: Upstream contributions to Blender's curve sculpting and geometry editing pipeline: interpolated curve radius initialization, and multi-point selection with slider control for curve mapping. 5 pull requests accepted.
summaryCn: 向 Blender 上游贡献曲线雕刻与几何编辑管线：曲线半径的插值式初始化，以及曲线映射的多点选择与滑块控制。5 个 pull request 已合入官方仓库。
abstract: Blender initialized newly sculpted hair curves from fixed values, so a groom did not inherit the radius and other vertex attributes of the geometry it was grown among. This contribution to the curve sculpting and geometry editing pipeline interpolates those attributes from neighbouring existing curves instead, and carries the change through the user interface and the user-facing documentation, including its Chinese translation. A second thread of work targets curve mapping: a long-standing interaction issue was fixed, and multi-point selection with slider control was added across all curve-mapping operations. Five pull requests have been accepted into the official repository. In a codebase of this size the work is dominated by reading rather than writing: each change has to follow established conventions, thread through both the data layer and the interface, and clear public review before it lands.
abstractCn: Blender 中新雕刻的毛发曲线以固定值初始化，因此不会继承其所生长环境中已有几何的半径等顶点属性。本项贡献面向曲线雕刻与几何编辑管线，改为从邻近已有曲线插值这些属性，并将改动贯穿到用户界面与面向用户的文档（含中文翻译）。另一条工作线针对曲线映射：修复了一处由来已久的交互问题，并为所有曲线映射操作新增多点选择与滑块控制。目前已有 5 个 pull request 合入官方仓库。在这样体量的代码库中，工作的主体是读代码而非写代码：每个改动都要遵循既有约定、贯穿数据层与界面层，并通过公开评审才能合入。

title: GPU (OpenGL) based Renderer Development
titleCn: 基于 GPU（OpenGL）的渲染器开发
summary: Long-term personal C++/OpenGL real-time rendering engine: 30,000+ lines, 600+ commits, with PBR, SDFs, real-time global illumination, and reproductions of 3 SIGGRAPH works.
summaryCn: 长期维护的个人 C++/OpenGL 实时渲染引擎：3 万+ 行、600+ 次提交，包含 PBR、SDF、实时全局光照，以及 3 个 SIGGRAPH 作品复现。
abstract: Real-time rendering techniques are most reliably understood by implementing them, but renderers written at course scale rarely reach the methods that decide whether an image is physically correct. This is a real-time rendering engine written from scratch in C++ and modern OpenGL over more than four years, spanning 30,000+ lines across 600+ commits. It covers physically based rendering and radiometry, high-quality shadowing, signed distance fields, spatio-temporal denoising, and real-time global illumination, and reproduces three SIGGRAPH works alongside a reading of 30+ foundational and state-of-the-art graphics papers. Because every technique lands in one coherent pipeline rather than an isolated demo, the engine doubles as a testbed where each addition is validated against the others, and as sustained practice in GPU architecture, high-performance computing, and shader programming.
abstractCn: 实时渲染技术最可靠的理解方式是把它实现出来，但课程规模的渲染器往往触及不到那些决定画面是否物理正确的方法。本项目是一个从零用 C++ 与现代 OpenGL 编写、持续四年以上的实时渲染引擎，累计 30,000+ 行代码、600+ 次提交。内容覆盖基于物理的渲染与辐射度学、高质量阴影、符号距离场、时空去噪与实时全局光照，并在研读 30+ 篇基础与前沿图形学论文的同时复现了 3 个 SIGGRAPH 工作。由于每项技术都落在同一条连贯管线中而非孤立的 demo 里，这个引擎同时充当了相互验证的实验平台，以及在 GPU 架构、高性能计算与着色器编程上的长期训练。

title: CUDA Image Processing Operator Development
titleCn: CUDA 图像处理算子开发
summary: CUDA-accelerated Python image processing and computer vision library: convolution, geometric transforms, dithering, morphology, and texture segmentation on the GPU.
summaryCn: CUDA 加速的 Python 图像处理与计算机视觉库：卷积、几何变换、抖动、形态学和纹理分割均在 GPU 上实现。
abstract: Classical image-processing operators are normally studied through library calls that hide the memory behaviour actually determining their cost on a GPU. Built for CS207: Image Data Science, this project implements a CUDA-accelerated Python library for image processing and computer vision from scratch, covering convolution, geometric transformations including non-linear warps, dithering, morphological operations, and texture segmentation. The operators are exposed as PyTorch extensions callable directly from Python, which keeps host-device copies out of the pipeline, and are tuned with shared-memory staging to raise cache hit rates and reduce memory traffic. The library therefore serves as a concrete account of how operator throughput on a GPU is governed by memory access rather than arithmetic.
abstractCn: 经典图像处理算子通常是通过库调用来学习的，而库调用恰好隐藏了真正决定其 GPU 开销的内存行为。本项目基于 CS207: Image Data Science 课程，从零实现了一个 CUDA 加速的 Python 图像处理与计算机视觉库，涵盖卷积、几何变换（含非线性扭曲）、抖动、形态学操作与纹理分割。算子以 PyTorch 扩展的形式暴露、可从 Python 直接调用，使主机与设备间的内存拷贝不进入流水线；并借助 shared memory 暂存等手段提升缓存命中、降低内存吞吐。由此，这个库成为一份具体的说明：GPU 上算子的吞吐由内存访问而非算术运算决定。
